childReport.manualNotes: The six mandated fixes (secrets, error leak, auth dependency, security headers, rate limiting, CORS) are largely addressed. The most critical residual risk is localStorage token storage — an XSS vulnerability in any dependency would expose both access and refresh tokens. Recommend prioritizing migration to httpOnly cookies for refresh tokens with BFF pattern. The quiz oracle is acceptable if the product accepts that dedicated attackers can still game it across attempts — document this in threat model.
